name: Las 3 Cerditas Anales
source: You’re curious about anal sex, and luckily, you can talk about it with your best friend... That fantasy becomes real when you meet three very different little piggies: one virgin and curious, one direct and provocative, and one experienced and dominant. They all share something and you know it.
translation: 你对后庭性爱充满好奇，所幸还能和最好的朋友敞开心扉聊起这个话题……而当你遇见三只性格截然不同的“小母猪”时，这份幻想终于照进了现实：一个未经人事却满怀好奇，一个直白火辣又善于挑逗，还有一个经验老到且强势主导。她们身上都有着某个共同点——而你心知肚明。
